implemented: GET /v1/catalog validates bounded CRS84 bbox and returns catalogVersion with supported intersections/approaches or an empty list.
GET /v1/signals returns explicit unavailable reasons for unknown targets, unsupported movements, expired signals and catalog mismatch.
WebSocket /v1/stream accepts subscribe/unsubscribe messages and emits snapshot/unavailable/error messages with requestId, streamEpoch and monotonic sequence.
Each StreamProtocol instance generates a fresh epoch so reconnect after server restart is distinguishable from old delayed messages.
Stream message size and per-connection subscription count are bounded.

scenarios: Invalid bbox returns 400; empty supported area returns 200 with empty catalog lists.
Golden catalog bbox returns supported approaches only.
Unknown approachKey and catalogVersion mismatch return unavailable instead of fake signals.
Reconnect starts at sequence 1 with a new streamEpoch and full snapshot.
